messages.author: 3c04c342136fe2e7
messages.subject: Students: Please submit your proposal
parts:
Dear prospective students for R / GSoC 2010,

Something we discussed among the mentors (and which you may have heard from
the mentor you are working with) is that you really should submit your
proposals sooner rather than later.

Remember that the proposals get voted upon by all mentors, so you want many
eyeballs on your proposal early rather than late.

And once submitted, you can still edit, enhance, augment, clarify, ... at
will. Following the 'many eyeballs make all bugs shallow' principle in open
source, you are likely to be better off by submitting early and having many
proof readers rather than discussing with just your mentor.

So please plan on submitting within the next day or two -- as opposed to at
the very end of the deadline near April 9.

Feel free to send questions back to the list here.

Regards, Dirk

--
